Strong in microservices, event-drivenarchitecture, serverless, CI/CD, and observability. Hands-on with AI/ML integration fordecisioning, dynamic pricing and recommendations; comfortable leveraging AI developer tools(Cursor, Copilot) to improve quality and velocity. Organization: EPAM (Client: Atlassian) — RemoteEnvironment: LlamaIndex, Anthropic Claude API, Node.js, Redis, WebSockets, Google CalendarAPI, Microsoft Outlook Calendar APIDescription: Developed a real-time scheduling agent integrating LlamaIndex with Google andOutlook calendar APIs. Integrated an intelligent conversational agent that automatically resolvestime-zone conflicts, reschedules dropouts, and delivers automated pre-interview reminders.Roles & Responsibilities:• Built real-time multi-calendar scheduling workflows with automated conflict resolution andrescheduling.• Automated 90% of manual recruiter coordination tasks, reducing interviewdropouts/no-shows by 30%.• Implemented conversational scheduling using LlamaIndex and Anthropic Claude API, withRedis and WebSockets for low-latency state and real-time updates.Organization: Emirates National Bank Dubai (D4Insight) — Remote | Mar 2025 – PresentEnvironment: Node.js (TypeScript, Nest/Express), Microservices, AWS, PostgreSQL/DynamoDB,Kafka/RabbitMQ, Docker, GitHub Actions, DatadogDescription: Built a fault-tolerant decisioning platform orchestrating multiple AI/ML models forcredit-risk based on repayment patterns and behavioral data; enabled real-time approvals withexplainability and continuous-feedback loops.Roles & Responsibilities:• Designed microservices with saga/outbox patterns for reliable workflows.• Implemented model orchestration (inference routing, retraining hooks, feedback capture).• Automated compliance checks with LLM-driven document parsing.• Established observability (tracing, logs, metrics) and CI/CD for safe rollouts.Loan Decision Management System (Personal & Corporate Lending) — SeniorSoftware Developer
